items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-9 of the iterate spec each have an implementation and a test; nothing beyond the issue's reported items plus the agreed evidence field.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Gateway failures stay per-leg errors with redacted reasons; token-param retry fires only on a rejection naming the parameter; a failing future in _run_gateway is caught and redacted.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: gateway_evidence records header NAMES only and a sanitized URL (asserted: no key/header value in the result JSON); https enforcement unchanged; no secrets in source.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Outcome tests with a happy and an error path per AC (exclusive/fail-closed, retry vs no-retry, marker schema accept/reject); the adopt dependency test is unmocked (find_spec) so it catches the original defect.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Two parallel legs as before; at most one extra request on a rejected token parameter.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New code follows the module's dual-import shim and naming; new test files split to stay under 300 lines. external_review.py grew by one helper (_run_gateway) - already over the soft limit before this change.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: external_review.py stdout -> review_payloads/record_review_pass/review_marker covered by the schema-6 round trip; .env.local scaffold -> parse_env_file covered by test_validate_env_gateway.
